data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Lonni was a name for the goddess Aphrodite, meaning ‘bright, shining one’. It can also be derived from the Greek word ‘longein’, meaning ‘to draw near’ or ‘to attract’. As a Christian name, Lonni represents the light of faith, drawing near to God and shining brightly for others. The name Lonni carries the meaning “Light, Torch” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lonni usually hope their child will grow to embody light, torch and live with faith, good character and purpose.
